scope: Regenerate the same 236 training windows and retain full-resolution teacher posteriors before any sequence-level training.
required_checks: Rebuilt feature crops equal the existing bank exactly.
Aligned 67-step posteriors equal the existing bank exactly.
Source roles, source/PCM/feature hashes and row order match the original bank.
Full posteriors are finite, nonnegative and normalized.
Only original training sources and backgrounds are read.
limits: Teacher CTC outputs are weak phonetic predictions, not human transcripts or a replacement for binary wake labels. No new validation, speaker, microphone or board access.
